_comment: Providers that published their own retirement notice. A measured death takes fourteen days of
silence to confirm; an announced one takes a sentence from the operator, and waiting two weeks
to record it would be theatre.
Every entry carries the operator's exact words, the URL, the date we read it, and what the
endpoint answers today - so a reader can check the death the same way they can check a quota.

providers.quote: As of July 30, 2026, GitHub Models is now retired. The playground, model catalog, inference API, and bring your own key (BYOK) are no longer available to any customer, including existing customers with active usage.
Meta shut down its hosted Llama API Public Preview on July 6, 2026.
